requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 60 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Turin is a geographic constraint handled by the Location Agent, and energy class and public transport proximity are not reference columns.
User prefers energy class C or better (A1-A4, B, C). Stated as a preference, so this is for ranking and should not be treated as a strict exclusion.
User wants the building near public transport. Value set to the 75th percentile of mobility (70.93), rounded to 71.
The building is to become a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is essential. Value set to the 75th percentile of education (75.14), rounded to 75.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters office-type properties (Uffici e assimilabili) with surface_area >= 850 m², within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, energy class A1–C, mobility score >= 71 and education score >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance from the coordinates, nearest first. No comune_code predicate is applied, since the place name is not a cadastral code.
